title: Sprint 5 — Production Operations
description: Handle production incidents and automate server management.

tickets.title: Ticket 1 — Investigate a High CPU Incident
tickets.description:
Find the process.
Identify the cause.
Resolve it.
Document the investigation.

tickets.title: Ticket 2 — Recover from a Disk Full Incident
tickets.description:
Locate large files.
Free space safely.
Prevent recurrence.

tickets.title: Ticket 3 — Build a Server Health Dashboard
tickets.description:
Create a Bash script that reports
CPU
Memory
Disk
Load
Running services
Failed services

tickets.title: Ticket 4 — Automate User Provisioning
tickets.description:
Given a CSV of employees,
Automatically
Create users
Assign groups
Create home directories
Set permissions

tickets.title: Ticket 5 — Build a Log Monitoring System
tickets.description:
Continuously monitor logs.
Alert when
ERROR appears
Disk reaches 90%
Service stops

tickets.title: Ticket 6 — Perform a Complete Server Backup and Restore
tickets.description:
Take a backup.
Delete the application.
Restore everything successfully.
Verify data integrity.

tickets.title: Ticket 7 — Secure a Production Server
tickets.description:
Apply a security checklist including:
Disable root SSH login
Enforce SSH key authentication
Configure automatic security updates
Install and configure Fail2Ban
Remove unused packages and services
Audit user accounts and permissions
Document every change and verify the server remains accessible.

tickets.title: Ticket 8 — Capstone: Build a Production Linux Server
tickets.description:
Provision a fresh Ubuntu server and configure it end-to-end:
Secure remote access with SSH keys
Firewall and intrusion protection
Docker and Docker Compose
PostgreSQL or MySQL
Nginx reverse proxy
Deploy a Django application
Automated backups
Health monitoring scripts
Log management
One-command deployment script
Complete setup and recovery documentation
